company_name: Sen Huan Electrical Technology Co., Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: High — the company manufactures sealing components and new polymer materials specifically for the semiconductor and LCD panel industries.
summary: Shanghai Senhuan Electrical Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in the production of sealing components, particularly O-rings, and is committed to developing new polymer materials for the semiconductor industry. With a focus on quality and customer needs, the company operates a Class 10,000 cleanroom production facility to meet the stringent cleanliness requirements of semiconductor manufacturing.
capabilities: Manufacturing of O-rings for semiconductor applications
Development of new polymer materials for semiconductor and LCD panel industries

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Shanghai and operates a manufacturing facility in the Lingang New Area.
